newsitem.title: ITALY: Polite Italian bank robbers leave with a handshake.
newsitem.headline: Polite Italian bank robbers leave with a handshake.

text.p: Robbers held up a bank in Italy on Friday and left with a handshake and a polite apology.

"This money will really help," the Italian news agency ANSA quoted the masked men, armed with knives, as telling two bank staff before locking them in a room and making their getaway with tens of millions of lire.
It said the robbers shook hands with the staff and said sorry. The report said the hold-up happened in the village of San Vittore near Cesena in central Italy but gave no other details.
